errors.why: `Long Extension (Posições Compradas) e Market Neutral (Mercado Neutro)` — here the parenthetical glosses the STRATEGY, so the long-position sense is imprecise. One of the seven occurrences of the form; the other six are plain long positions, so the form stays where amendment 37 put it and this is the declared residual. `Long Extension` fires as technical.long_extension on its own name in the same sentence, so the strategy is not lost.
